title:
Feb 17, 2026
Announcements
Anthropic and Infosys collaborate to build AI agents for telecommunications and other regulated industries
tldr: Anthropic and Infosys are partnering to engineer and deploy advanced AI agents specifically tailored for the telecommunications and other highly regulated industries. This collaboration aims to develop robust, domain-specific agentic solutions addressing complex operational challenges and compliance requirements within these critical sectors.

title: Building multi-agent systems: When and how to use them
tldr: This post explores the architectural considerations and strategic applications of multi-agent systems, outlining scenarios where cooperative AI agents can significantly enhance complex workflows. It discusses common patterns and decision frameworks for deploying such systems effectively.

title: Building agents with Skills: Equipping agents for specialized work
tldr: This blog post details the methodology for developing specialized AI agents by integrating "Skills," which enable agents to perform targeted tasks efficiently. It covers the technical considerations for equipping agents with specific functionalities and knowledge domains.

title: Extending Claude’s capabilities with skills and MCP servers
tldr: This post details the technical framework for extending Claude's functionality through custom "skills" and scalable Multi-Context Processing (MCP) servers. It describes architectural patterns and engineering considerations for integrating specialized capabilities and handling complex, long-running agentic tasks.

title: Customize AI agent browsing with proxies, profiles, and extensions in Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Browser
tldr: AWS announces advanced customization capabilities for AI agents using Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Browser, allowing developers to configure browsing behavior with proxies, user profiles, and extensions. These features provide granular control over agent interactions with web environments, enhancing their adaptability and security for specialized tasks.

title: GPT-5.2 derives a new result in theoretical physics
tldr: OpenAI's GPT-5.2 has achieved a significant milestone by autonomously deriving a novel result in theoretical physics, showcasing advanced reasoning and problem-solving capabilities beyond current human-programmed methods. This demonstrates the model's potential for accelerating scientific discovery and pushing the boundaries of AI-driven research.

title: Introducing Lockdown Mode and Elevated Risk labels in ChatGPT
tldr: OpenAI has introduced Lockdown Mode and Elevated Risk labels in ChatGPT to enhance safety and control, providing users with stricter operational parameters and clearer indications of potentially sensitive outputs. These features represent advancements in model alignment and responsible AI deployment, enabling more robust risk management for diverse applications.

title: Beyond rate limits: scaling access to Codex and Sora
tldr: OpenAI is implementing new architectural and operational strategies to scale access for its advanced models, Codex and Sora, moving beyond traditional rate limits to accommodate increasing demand. This involves significant infrastructure enhancements and resource allocation optimizations to ensure high availability and performance for diverse user bases.

title: Scaling social science research
tldr: OpenAI is exploring methods to scale social science research using advanced AI, focusing on leveraging large language models and computational tools to analyze complex social phenomena more efficiently. This involves developing new paradigms for data collection, analysis, and hypothesis testing, potentially accelerating insights in various social science domains.

title: On Agent Frameworks and Agent Observability
tldr: This LangChain blog post delves into the design principles and challenges of robust agent frameworks, emphasizing the critical importance of comprehensive agent observability for debugging, performance analysis, and reliability. It outlines architectural considerations for building transparent and manageable multi-agent systems.

title: Custom Kernels for All from Codex and Claude
tldr: This Hugging Face blog post unveils a method to democratize custom CUDA kernel development, enabling their generation and deployment via AI models like Codex and Claude for optimizing agent skills. This innovation aims to accelerate specialized hardware-level computations for AI workloads, making performance tuning more accessible.

title: Build long-running MCP servers on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore with Strands Agents integration
tldr: AWS details the process of deploying long-running Multi-Context Processing (MCP) servers on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, leveraging integration with Strands Agents for persistent, stateful agentic workflows. This enables developers to architect sophisticated, multi-step AI agents that maintain context across extended interactions and complex tasks.

title: Gemini 3 Deep Think: Advancing science, research and engineering
tldr: DeepMind introduced Gemini 3 Deep Think, a new iteration of their foundational model, specifically engineered to accelerate scientific discovery, complex research analysis, and advanced engineering problem-solving. This release emphasizes enhanced reasoning, multi-modality, and robust performance on highly technical tasks.

title: Introducing GPT-5.3-Codex-Spark
tldr: OpenAI has announced GPT-5.3-Codex-Spark, a new foundational model specifically designed for advanced code generation and complex multi-modal reasoning, building upon the capabilities of the GPT-5 series and Codex family. This release promises significant improvements in developer productivity, agentic coding, and the ability to process and generate diverse content beyond just code.

title: OpenEnv in Practice: Evaluating Tool-Using Agents in Real-World Environments
tldr: Hugging Face introduces "OpenEnv," a practical framework for rigorously evaluating AI agents that leverage external tools within complex, real-world operational environments. The post details methodologies for assessing agent performance, robustness, and reliability in dynamic scenarios, pushing the boundaries of autonomous agent deployment.

title: NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Nano 30B MoE model is now available in Amazon SageMaker JumpStart
tldr: NVIDIA's Nemotron 3 Nano 30B MoE model, a Mixture-of-Experts architecture designed for efficiency and performance, has been made available on Amazon SageMaker JumpStart. This provides developers with easier access to a powerful, compact model for fine-tuning and deployment within AWS's managed MLOps environment.

title: The Death of Traditional Testing: Agentic Development Broke a 50-Year-Old Field, JiTTesting Can Revive It
tldr: This Meta AI engineering post discusses how the rise of agentic development has challenged traditional software testing methodologies, a field largely unchanged for decades. It introduces "JiTTesting" (Just-in-Time Testing) as a novel approach designed to integrate seamlessly with AI agents and dynamic code generation workflows, aiming to restore testing efficacy.

title: Mastering Amazon Bedrock throttling and service availability: A comprehensive guide
tldr: This comprehensive guide from AWS addresses the critical operational challenges of managing Amazon Bedrock's service availability and throttling mechanisms for production AI workloads. It provides deep technical insights and best practices for configuring, monitoring, and optimizing Bedrock usage to ensure consistent performance and reliability.

title: Harness engineering: leveraging Codex in an agent-first world
tldr: OpenAI's "Harness Engineering" initiative details best practices and novel architectural patterns for effectively integrating and leveraging Codex within nascent agent-first AI systems. The article explores techniques for optimizing model interactions, managing complex workflows, and ensuring robust performance in autonomous agent deployments.
